high_level_description: Strictly non-photographic, wordless Chitrakathi painted-card illustration: three Thakar storytellers independently complete the same secular forest scene; two cards match in every placement and rest together on one mat, while the divergent third card remains apart, all rendered with forceful profiles, flat mineral colors, black contours and no writing or arrows.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A handmade tan-paper field forms one frontal tableau with a dark red upper band, a black lower ground band and sparse flat leaf forms at the outer edges. The central area remains open so all three cards can be compared at once. No temple, deity, epic hero, photographic light, modeled volume, perspective room, alphabet, numeral, caption, arrow, voting diagram, podium, crown, badge, interface or national flag appears.

elements.desc: Adult Thakar Chitrakathi painter seated at the upper-left, medium-brown skin, black hair tied low, rust tunic, mustard shoulder cloth and dark trousers. Their strong side-profile face and concentrated gaze point toward the first completed card below; both hands rest beside the pigments after independent work, with no copying screen, command gesture, rank marker or religious prop.

Adult Thakar Chitrakathi painter seated at the upper-center, dark-brown skin, short wavy black hair, indigo tunic, cream shoulder cloth and rust trousers. They face the second completed card with an attentive neutral expression, holding one clean brush above a separate pigment bowl; no shared tracing sheet, authority badge, crown, judging tool, electronic device or sacred object appears.

Adult Thakar Chitrakathi painter seated at the upper-right, medium-brown skin, braided black hair, mustard tunic, dark red shoulder cloth and indigo trousers. They look toward the third card with a calm independent posture, setting down a brush beside their own palette; no visual contact, copied template, voting token, punishment symbol, hierarchy marker or modern machine appears.

First rectangular painted card resting on the left half of one shared woven mat, showing a red sun in the upper-left, one black forked tree at center, a blue deer facing right beneath it and three ochre ground mounds. Every position, proportion and color exactly matches the second card; no letters, numerals, border legend or signature appears.

Second rectangular painted card resting directly beside the first on the same woven mat, showing the identical red upper-left sun, central black forked tree, right-facing blue deer and three ochre ground mounds at exactly matching scale and placement. The card contains no altered detail, alphabet, numeral, signature, caption, check mark, award seal or connecting arrow.

Third rectangular painted card resting alone on a separate small mat at lower-right, showing the red sun in the upper-right, the same black tree shifted left, a blue deer facing left and only two ochre ground mounds. The divergence is concrete and immediately comparable, without rejection cross, angry face, text, number, warning label, ranking mark or damaged paper.

Single broad woven comparison mat beneath the two matching cards, made from flat alternating dark-red and tan bands and leaving a narrow equal gap between them. It does not elevate either painter and carries no throne, central judge, ballot box, pointer, arrow, written rule, numerical score, medal, colored status light or connection to the separate outlier mat.
